0022600152.text: The Timberwolves (4-2, 6th in the West and 3rd in the Northwest) visit the Spurs (3-2, 8th in the West and 4th in the Southwest) in Minnesota's seventh game of the season, with Minnesota on a one-game win streak and San Antonio on a three-game streak. Minnesota is missing Anthony Edwards (out after knee surgery, averaging 33.3 points per game this season) and Donte DiVincenzo (out after Achilles surgery), while San Antonio is without Jayden Quaintance (knee surgery) and Tobias Harris (calf strain). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but the Timberwolves won the 2025-26 regular-season series 2-1 before losing the 2025-26 playoff series 2-4, and the most recent meeting was a 139-109 San Antonio win in Minneapolis in the playoffs on May 15, 2026.
